#60 - Shocked Everyone With A Battle

Chapter 60 A battle that shocked everyone

"You will regret rejecting the king's second proposal." Malin Tran said suddenly when the two started wrestling together.

"I will definitely not regret it." Arthur still held back his strength in his hands, but he didn't want to fall behind others.

"Hmph!" Malin Tran sneered and began to use his strength. After preparing to block Arthur, he ended the farce with a sword.

It was a bit embarrassing for the king to choose him to deal with such an unknown young man.

"Yeah~" He shouted, exerting force all over his body from the soles of his feet, legs, core of waist and abdomen, and upper arms at the same time, preparing to achieve great results in one fell swoop.

"Well done, Ser Trant, fuck him," Cleo encouraged the Kingsguard.

Meryn Tran has an extraordinary relationship with the Lannisters, and Cleo naturally regards him as one of his own.

"Young man, surrender if you can't hold on any longer," Barristan reminded.

He was worried about Arthur, fearing that Sir Teran would cause harm and give him a severe blow.

The onlookers were chirping and watching the two people's "performance".

The biggest advantage of being a member of the King's Landing community is that you can see all kinds of big scenes.

To them, the love, hatred, and power games of the nobles are just performances.

No matter who wins or loses, they are the most loyal viewers and spectators.

King Robert, Ed and other princes and ministers watched the wrestling between the two.

Although they understood that Arthur's defeat was only a matter of time, it was surprising that they had persisted for so long.

The two of them seemed to be the same height, but Malin Tran was much stronger. It was obvious who was stronger.

"Bye bye." After Arthur felt the limit of Malin Tran's power, he suddenly exerted force and blocked him in one fell swoop.

Then, without giving his opponent a chance to react, he swung the ice and slashed at the Kingsguard, who had taken off his white armor, and slashed several times.

Naturally, Malin Tran also held up his sword to block it.

The sound of metal and stone clashing suddenly drowned out the whispers in the throne room.

"How is this possible?" Robert was so shocked that his eyes almost fell out.

It's common sense that body shape determines strength.

Anyone with strong strength is always related to a strong body.

This Arthur looks a little thin, but he can actually suppress Malin Tran in strength.

It was even suppressed to the point where the Kingsguard could only block with his sword, but could not fight back at all.

Duke Ed was also surprised and speechless when he saw the scene.

Just now, he thought that what Arthur said about defeating twenty people was an exaggeration, but now it seems that it is probably true.

Loras, the Knight of Flowers, was also stunned by Arthur's performance, "This is a bit strong."

Renly, the Duke of Storm's End, could not understand the specific combat prowess of the two men, but he knew very well that Arthur had the upper hand. He asked his friend: "How strong is it?"

"In terms of strength, I am far from Arthur's opponent." Loras replied while staring at the situation on the field without blinking.

Barristan, the fearless captain of the Kingsguard, suddenly felt that his worries were unnecessary.

Based on this young man's performance, the one who couldn't hold on was probably his nominal brother Malin Tran.

Some of the people watching changed their views.

"This Arthur is actually so strong!"

"It seems that what he said about one person knocking down twenty people is true."

Some people disagreed, and even though they were slapped in the face, they still insisted on their previous opinions: "It was obviously Sir Tran who gave in to him, and he took the opportunity."

"That's right, Marinette is the Kingsguard, the King's personal bodyguard!"

There were many people who held this view. In their unbelievable eyes, Arthur cut off Marinette Lan's sword with one sword, ending the fight.

Malin Tran stared at the half-cut sword in his hand, and then at the half-cut sword on the ground, with mixed feelings in his heart.

Just now, he thought he could end this competition neatly and prove his white-robed strength in front of the people and courtiers.

But he didn't expect to be defeated by this young man's sword.

Although the opponent had the blessing of the Valyrian steel sword, he was still defeated. When word spread, he was completely embarrassed.

Cleo and his cousin looked blank. They thought that Arthur would not be able to defeat a Kingsguard in any case.

Unexpectedly, the ruthless reality would break through the psychological defense line in a blink of an eye.

Even worse if Malin Tran loses, they may be punished by the king.

Arthur glanced at his silent opponent, then looked around at the stunned onlookers. After finding a sense of pleasure and spiritual satisfaction from their shocked faces, he turned to the Iron Throne.

"Excuse me, have I proven my strength?"

He opened his arms and looked at Robert who was a little stunned with a smile.

"Ah, yes, that's right." Robert was stunned for a moment before answering.

Anyone with a discerning eye could see that their king was surprised by this result, but considering that everyone's reactions were similar, no one cared about it.

"Mr. Arthur has the strength to defeat these twenty gangsters. This is a fact that everyone can see. Therefore, I believe that Cleo and his cousin deceived their king for something..."

Robert lost his temper fiercely at the queen's cousins, and ordered them to get out of the house after ordering them not to retaliate against the tavern couple.

Considering that they didn't actually do much evil, but were punished by Arthur, this ending is actually acceptable.

As for the rest, Robert was too lazy to deal with it, leaving everyone to pat their butts and slip away.

There are still a few beauties in the room waiting for him to visit!

When Barristan and other Kingsguards followed the king out, most of them looked at Arthur carefully before leaving.

It seemed that they were confirming that this tall and thin handsome guy really defeated Meryn Tran.

Arthur didn't care about these. He personally handed the ice back to the Prime Minister, Duke Eddard, who walked down the stairs. "This big sword is very sharp, worthy of being a Varsteel sword."

After Eddard took the sword, he hung it around his waist.

"I'm sorry for questioning you before. From the previous and subsequent situations, you are an upright, kind, strong and brave person." Now the Prime Minister spoke more politely.

As the adopted son of the Eagle House Arryn, whose family language is "high as glory", he actually has a bit of moral cleanliness.

He has a good impression of people like Arthur who help him.

"I just did what a normal person should do. After all, anyone who saw the situation at that time would say that it was almost over."

Ed nodded seriously, agreeing with Arthur's statement.

"You can leave now. After such a commotion, I think the Queen's cousin will definitely not dare to bother you again."

Arthur smiled and said goodbye.

He wished that Cleo and his cousin would come to his house again and let him beat them up again.

As for the onlookers, they gradually walked out after the king slipped away, and now almost all of them have left.

"Sir, can I follow you?" Just as Arthur and Patrick and others were walking out, a voice came.
